P07.rationale: A social-proof apparatus is present in the form of a '100+ AI-Projekte' statistic box and specific case study names (e.g., Hausarztpraxis Dr. M.) that serve as proof points.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations are bound to numbers with specific metrics like '30-50% Kostensenkung', '+15 Bewerbungen', and '+7 hochwertige Anfragen' clearly displayed in the layout.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks, statistics, and imagery without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: There is an intentional background texture/atmosphere created by the dark blue gradient overlay on the photo which adds depth and mood appropriate to a professional report.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo is treated with a darkening scrim/overlay so that any overlaid text (like the headline) stays perfectly readable against the background.

P16.rationale: A device/product mockup is not explicitly shown as a standalone object, but the context of 'AI-Projekte' and 'Automatisierungssysteme' implies digital tools are central to the business model presented.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business rather than generic stock; the founder's portrait appears authentic and contextualized within his own office environment.

N08.rationale: There is no sparse, purposeless dead whitespace; every area of the page contains meaningful content or structural elements like text blocks and data points.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo with no scrim; all overlaid typography is clearly legible due to the dark background treatment applied over the image.
